Hi Maya / Tom —

Thanks again for the call earlier. Quick synthesis of what we heard and a recommended activation path so we can get a pilot running in the next 3–4 weeks. High level: you want to reduce manual triage time for clinical coding and improve extraction precision from patient notes while keeping all data inside your VPC for PHI controls.

Key pain points we heard
- High manual effort to normalize clinician notes across EHR exports (~25 FTE hours/week).
- Occasional hallucination on rare abbreviations and low recall on discharge summaries.
- Need for audit trail and per-request logging for compliance reviews.

Goals for a successful pilot (measurable)
1) Precision >= 92% on ICD-10 code extraction on the 2k record blind set you provide.
2) Reduce average human review time by 40% on the validated sample.
3) End-to-end latency for inference within 400ms p50 on batch inference of 8–16 seqs.
4) Evidence and logging visible to your security team for SOC-2 review.

Proposed POC scope (4 weeks, phased)
Phase 0 — Access & data prep (week 0)
- Provide 2k de-identified (or VPC-hosted PHI) records and sample export format.
- Grant read-only S3 access / secure transfer.
- Monica/Ben to provide access inventory template (attached).

Phase 1 — Model fitting & prompt suite (week 1)
- Redwood will provision a dedicated environment (private deployment option) and run an initial prompt/eval slate against sample data.
- Build a prompt set focusing on extraction and normalization rules; produce a prompt-eval matrix.

Phase 2 — Integration & eval (weeks 2–3)
- Run batched inference on your sample pipeline, measure precision/recall, and iterate on prompt set.
- Add KV/prefix caching for repeated patient notes to optimize cost/latency.

Phase 3 — Review & next steps (week 4)
- Deliver evaluation report, runbook for production readiness, and recommended rollout path (Dedicated or Hosted with VPC egress).
